How to Use ChatGPT as an Example Machine

Jennifer Gonzalez
February 20, 2023

ChatGPT can be used by teachers to quickly produce multiple examples and non-examples of complex concepts for classroom discussion.

This approach saves planning time and helps students analyze nuance in writing and reasoning.
